sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Borobudur Temple Compounds
sources.note: Direct official record read, description, Brief synthesis and Authenticity. Use eighth/ninth-century building and architectural/modern restoration evidence. Avoid its dubious five-century Sailendra reign statement and simplistic discovery framing.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Prambanan Temple Compounds
sources.note: Direct official record read. Description, Brief synthesis and Authenticity. Page contains eighth/ninth/tenth-century generalizations; use ninth-century Loro Jonggrang statement corroborated by Bastiawan et al., and avoid an exact completion year.

sources.title: Balai Konservasi Borobudur, Relief Nelayan dan Pedagang di Candi Borobudur (2017)
sources.note: Original government page indexed text read; direct opening failed. Reproducible query: site:kebudayaan.kemdikbud.go.id/bkborobudur/relief-nelayan-dan-pedagang-di-candi-borobudur/ jala. Karmawibhangga panel 1; wording kept to market, nets and bamboo fishing equipment.

sources.title: Balai Konservasi Borobudur, Relief Musik di Candi Borobudur (2023)
sources.note: Original government full indexed text read: Karmawibhangga panels 20, 39, 52, 125 and Jataka gallery 1 lower west panel 66. Do not confuse the ancient carvings with modern reconstructed sounds, or adopt modern musical-instrument examples from other articles.

sources.title: Jan Wisseman Christie, Texts and Textiles in Medieval Java (1993)
sources.note: Original article indexed page 182 read via query "Texts and Textiles" "Christie" "cloth"; result pageId=T1_182. Direct opening showed article metadata and subsequent page request failed. Only the bounded ninth/early tenth-century charter gift-list finding is used.

sources.title: Direktorat Pelindungan Kebudayaan, Delineasi Situs Liyangan (2016)
sources.note: Original government full indexed text read, paragraphs on rice/charcoal/Tang ceramics and site layout. Original query site:kebudayaan.kemdikbud.go.id/dpk/delineasi-situs-liyangan/ padi. Its broad sixth-tenth-century range describes evidence, not a secure eruption date; recent volcanology used separately.

sources.title: Reconstruction of the circa 8th-9th century CE eruption of Mt. Sindoro that destroyed Liyangan, Journal of Volcanology and Geothermal Research 477 (2026), 108675
sources.note: Original publisher indexed abstract and Introduction read. Supports stilt houses, woven bamboo, irrigated fields, eruption deposits and no discovered contemporary human victims. Title estimates eighth/ninth century; introduction notes some younger finds and debated Rukam connection. Public prose leaves exact eruption date open.

sources.title: Dezso, Griffiths and Bastiawan, Charter of Pucangan (1041), DHARMA edition and translation

batchIdentityNotes.scope: Early Hindu-Buddhist Mataram/Medang of Central and East Java, not later Islamic Mataram. No new geometry and no additional associations.
batchIdentityNotes.mapEvidence: Four decoded imported MultiPolygons in world-600/700/800/900; all dated 600-1000. Early bounds105.144451E to115.501755E, south8.783407S/north6.289423S; later northward projection reaches1.369195S. Broad island footprints are not validated sovereignty.
batchIdentityNotes.publicCaveat: Opening explicitly qualifies 600/1000 and the Java/Bali/Borneo extent. Later East Java and 1041 retrospective witness are identified in prose.
batchIdentityNotes.chronology: Secure 778 Kalasan anchor; 855/929 organizational phase markers; no invented founder in600 or universal volcanic fall in1000/1006. Political shift east may precede Sindok; no exact eruption date for Liyangan.
batchIdentityNotes.sourceLimits: Reliefs are religious narratives rather than demographic reports. Cloth evidence uses dated charters. No unsupported medical treatments, toilets or universal schools introduced.
